name: rixl
description: Read media, analytics, billing and content data from Rixl with platform guidance Skills and the Rixl MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Read a Rixl organization's videos, images, feeds and posts, their playback and engagement metrics, and its invoices, usage and subscription, through the Rixl MCP server. Read-only: every exposed operation is a GET.
defaultPrompt: Show me my top videos by engagement this month
What is my current storage and bandwidth usage against my plan?
List the feeds in my project and the most recent posts in each
